name: RFP1
promptText:
From: julie@abc-coffee.com
Subject: RFQ - valve controllers for Paris

Hello,
I would like to order 80 valve controllers (SKU MAT-300080) for next week in Paris, France.
Customer: ABC Coffee SAS
Incoterm: DAP
Requested delivery date: 2026-04-24

Execution rules:
- Treat this as a customer email and preserve customer identity from the From line.
- Use QuotePlanningAgent as lead.
- Use real outputs from AcmeRetailPim, SapJouleAgent, ShippingAgent, and bedrock_legal_agent only.
- If any secondary detail is missing, make the standard assumption and continue instead of asking a question.
- Standard assumptions if needed: city-level destination estimate for Paris, DAP if incoterm missing, Net 30 payment terms, 30-day quote validity, weekday business delivery, single-shipment unless peers recommend otherwise.
- Only stop if no SKU or no identifiable destination city/country can be inferred.
- Return four sections: (1) machine JSON quote object, (2) executive summary in max 6 lines, (3) evidence by agent, (4) assumptions used.

name: RFP2
description: Golden RFQ - standard stock + delivery commitment (email format)
promptText:
From: julie@abc-coffee.com
Subject: RFQ - pressure sensors and valve controllers for Paris

Hello Quote Team,
Please provide a complete quote for:
- 120 pressure sensors (SKU MAT-200120)
- 80 valve controllers (SKU MAT-300080)
Customer: ABC Coffee SAS
Destination: Paris, France
Incoterm: DAP
Requested delivery date: 2026-04-27

Rules:
- Parse customer from the email context (From + Customer line). If these conflict, ask one clarification question.
- Use real outputs from AcmeRetailPim, SapJouleAgent, and ShippingAgent only.
- If stock is insufficient, propose exactly two alternatives: split shipment and nearest compatible substitute SKU.
- Return two sections: (1) machine JSON quote object, (2) executive summary in max 6 lines.

name: RFP3
description: Golden RFQ - margin-protected expedited quote (email format)
promptText:
From: procurement@novasteel.nl
Subject: Urgent expedited RFQ for Rotterdam

Hi Team,
Please prepare an expedited RFQ for 60 hydraulic pump kits (SKU MAT-400060).
Customer: NovaSteel BV
Delivery destination: Rotterdam, Netherlands
Incoterm: DDP
Requested delivery date: 2026-04-22

Rules:
- Prioritize on-time delivery while keeping gross margin above 18%.
- Pull catalog/specs from AcmeRetailPim, availability/pricing from SapJouleAgent, and transport options from ShippingAgent.
- If no option satisfies both date and margin, return status BLOCKED with top 2 trade-off options.
- Final answer must include: line items, source plant, shipping mode, cost breakdown, margin check, assumptions, risks.

name: RFP4
description: Golden RFQ - multi-line substitution and risk disclosure (email format)
promptText:
From: operations@alpine-energy.eu
Subject: RFQ - flow meters and gasket sets for Milan

Good morning,
Please quote the following request:
- 200 flow meters (SKU MAT-500200)
- 200 gasket sets (SKU MAT-700200)
Customer: Alpine Energy SA
Destination: Milan, Italy
Incoterm: FCA
Requested delivery date: 2026-04-30

Rules:
- Validate every SKU against AcmeRetailPim before pricing.
- If an SKU is discontinued or unavailable, propose one compatible substitute with explicit compatibility rationale.
- Use real SAP sourcing/availability and real ShippingAgent cost options; do not invent values.
- Final response must include: JSON output, per-line evidence source, and a concise risk register (supply, logistics, pricing).

name: OPS1
promptText:
From: ops-emea@acme-retail.com
Subject: Delayed order remediation for SO-2026-0042

Customer order SO-2026-0042 is now delayed by 4 days for delivery in Lyon, France.
Material: MAT-300080
Quantity: 80
Incoterm: DAP
Original requested delivery date: 2026-04-14

Execution rules:
- Use OrderExceptionTriageAgent as lead.
- Assess severity, query supporting agents as needed, and return 2 feasible recovery paths with customer impact, operational trade-offs, and recommended next action.
- Use real outputs only.
- If any secondary detail is missing, make the standard assumption and continue instead of asking a question.
- Standard assumptions if needed: city-level destination estimate for Lyon, standard industrial shipment dimensions/weight based on material and quantity, standard business-day delivery window, no special customs constraints for intra-France movement.
- Only stop if no order reference, no material/SKU, or no destination city/country can be inferred.
- Return four sections: (1) strict JSON remediation object, (2) concise business summary, (3) evidence by agent, (4) assumptions used.

name: OPS2
description: Reusable scenario - procurement and replenishment planning
promptText:
From: supply-planning@acme-retail.com
Subject: 14-day replenishment proposal for France

Please prepare a 14-day replenishment recommendation for the France distribution lane.
SKUs:
- MAT-200120 quantity 120
- MAT-300080 quantity 80
Destination: Paris, France
Need-by date: 2026-04-29

Task: Use ReplenishmentPlannerAgent as lead. Compare replenishment options using PIM specs, SAP availability/pricing, and shipping constraints. Return cost, lead-time, stockout risk, and a recommended option.
